title: Ruby dependency manifests reveal third-party services

comments.author: os
comments.text:
As a scanner user, I want Ruby dependency manifests analyzed, so that declared third-party services appear in canonical topology.

Feature: Ruby dependency manifest analysis
  Scenario: Runtime Ruby gems are declared in Gemfile and locked in Gemfile.lock
    Given a Ruby service with direct runtime gems and development or test-only gems
    When the structural scan analyzes its dependency manifests
    Then recognized runtime gems produce canonical third-party findings with locked versions and dependency_manifest source context
    And reliably identified development and test-only gems are excluded
    And manifest-only third parties receive a service hub flow

Out of scope: Ruby patterns, source detector/parser, data-action and evaluation gates, benchmark gold.
